title: [finding] queue-steward seat silent for 7 days — #5810 now in closed state while seat post #6016 still registers it 🟢 live
body:
Found while executing #9122 (re-pointing #5810's Routine-prompt case-law addresses). Filed unassigned, `finding` only — this is an observation about seat state, not a defect with a named code fix, and ⛔ I changed no state: the closure below was performed by another actor under the shared identity, and reverting it is not mine to do.

## Measured, 2026-08-16 ~15:3xZ, all via raw REST

| reading | value |
|---|---|
| #5810 (the steward's anchor) | state `closed`, `state_reason: completed`, `closed_at` 2026-08-16T14:33:57Z, closing comment is one line: 「已决定关闭此座位」 |
| #6016 (the `pm:seat` post — **单写手权威登记**) | state **open**, title 「[PM seat] queue steward (3-repo merge queues) — 🟢 Routine」, body still registers `trig_012yeNVMdFwXET5zvYQtUKXA`, cron hourly :15, fresh session; body untouched since 2026-08-14T18:31Z |
| last 巡检简报 on #5810 | **2026-08-09T22:21:13Z, round 85** — then nothing. 85 briefings exist, hourly, 2026-08-06 → 2026-08-09 |
| #4604 (the pointer page the anchor names) | state `closed`; its row still points at #6016 |

The three readings contradict each other: the registry says the seat is 🟢 live, the anchor says the seat is finished, and the production record says it stopped a week ago — **six days before** anyone wrote either of the other two.

## Why the silence is the part worth a card

The seat is not idle-by-design. Its own 收尾 clause makes a briefing mandatory whenever there is any observation or action, and only 「三仓零观测零动作」 permits a silent end — implausible for 7 consecutive days across three repos. Meanwhile other seats kept filing into it, and none of the four was answered:

- #6016 comment 2026-08-12T17:58Z — `domain:engine-core` seat, pin-chain observation (`check:objectui-pin-fresh` red for two independent devs)
- #6016 comments 2026-08-14T18:21Z and 18:31Z — `domain:spec` seat, first datapoint + reproduction for an `i18n-section-coverage` queue signature
- #5810 comment 2026-08-13T01:57Z — 疑似新 flaky，提请升级签名台账
- #5810 comment 2026-08-16T08:09:46Z — ledger 提请 for #9068 (a new queue-only signature)

The ledger is human-upgrade-only and the seat is the intended reader; those four are sitting in a dead inbox. #6016's own 车道分工变更 line moved 「被踢 PR 的已知 flaky 原样重投」 **off** the lane PMs and onto this seat — so if lanes still believe the registry, kicked PRs have had no owner for a week.

Also note #5810's own rollback recipe: 「delete_trigger + 本单失败注记 + #4604 行清空」. None of the three is evidenced on the anchor — the closing comment carries no session ID, no evidence, and no rollback note, which is what makes the intent unreadable from GitHub alone.

## What would resolve it (⛔ none of it is an agent action, hence `finding` and not `pm:queue`)

Whoever owns the decision states which reading is authoritative, and the losers get corrected in one pass:

- **seat retired** ⇒ #6016 flips to 🔴/retired by its incumbent seat PM (single-writer rule), the Routine is deleted in the Routines UI, and the pending 提请 above are re-homed (the ledger has no other reader);
- **seat live** ⇒ the anchor's state is the thing that is wrong, and the 7-day production gap is a separate, still-unexplained failure worth its own look — a Routine that stops firing silently is invisible to every GitHub-side check.

Refs: #5810 (anchor, now in closed state) · #6016 (seat post, 🟢) · #4604 (pointer page) · #9122 (the card this was found under) · #9068 (the most recent unanswered ledger 提请).

No `domain:*` label applied — routing is the triage seat's single-producer territory. Unassigned.
